subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The **__causes__** of war in the country are very pathetic.
solution: The correct answer is **"consequences."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Causes' **refers to a thing that gives rise to an action, phenomenon, or condition. ("कारण") • **Example: ***The **causes__** of famine are still untraceable.* • **'Consequences'** means the result or effect of an action, which can be positive or negative. (परिणाम, नतीजा, फल, प्रभाव) __ • **Example**: *Many people may lose their jobs as a **consequence**__ of recent poor sales.* • As we can see, 'causes' and 'consequences' are exactly opposite words. *Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 - 'occasions'** means a particular event or happening. (अवसर, मौक़ा, समय विशेष जब कुछ घटित हो) • **Option 2 - 'creations' **means something that has been made or brought into existence. (कोई नई वस्‍तु बनाने या अस्तित्व में लाने की क्रिया; नवनिर्माण) • **Option 4 - 'factors'** means a circumstance, fact or influence that contributes to a particular outcome. (किसी निर्णय, स्थिति आदि को प्रभावित करने वाला तत्‍व; कारक) 39:Tbd1, The correct answer is **"pulling someone's leg."**
